subject.title: chore: align Android icons with favicon mark

question: Should Android launcher icons use the rounded web/favicon mascot, or should launcher icons continue to match the current iOS red-lobster app icon?
rationale: Source inspection supports both interpretations of brand parity, and CI cannot decide the official launcher identity.

options.title: Use favicon mascot for Android launcher
options.body: Accept this PR direction after the contributor adds real Android launcher/app drawer proof that adaptive and legacy icons render correctly.

options.title: Keep launcher parity with iOS icon
options.body: Ask for a different Android asset set based on the current iOS launcher mark, or close this PR if favicon-style launcher parity is not desired.

recommendation.title: Use favicon mascot for Android launcher
recommendation.body: Accept this PR direction after the contributor adds real Android launcher/app drawer proof that adaptive and legacy icons render correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on Android mascot/product identity and prior app-icon merge context.
